title: Scrape data from a website into a file
examples: scrape product names and prices from http://localhost:8001/dynamic/
extract the table from this website
get all products from this site and save as csv
scrape this url
collect data from the iframes on this page
description:
1. Call scrape_analyze with the URL. Report what it found: static or dynamic, APIs, embedded JSON, number of iframes, blockers.
2. If the recommended strategy is 'stop' (CAPTCHA, login, robots.txt), explain why and stop.
3. Run the recommended extraction: api -> scrape_api (needs user confirmation), embedded -> scrape_embedded, iframes -> scrape_iframes, page -> scrape_page.
4. If the user named fields (e.g. name, price), call scrape_structure with those fields.
5. Call scrape_save (csv unless the user asked for json or xlsx).
6. Answer with: site type, method used and why, row count, file path.

title: Research a topic on the web
examples: search the web for the latest news about AI agents
find information about LangGraph
what is the current price of
look up who won
research this topic online
description:
1. Call web_search with a focused query.
2. Call web_read on the 1-2 most relevant results.
3. Answer in a short summary with the source links. Say clearly if results look outdated.

title: Analyze a data file (CSV or Excel)
examples: analyze sales.csv
what is the total revenue by region in sales_data.csv
which product sold the most
give me the top 5 rows by revenue
average order value in this spreadsheet
description:
1. Call data_describe to learn the exact column names.
2. Call data_analyze with the right operation (group_sum, top_n, mean...).
3. If the user asked for a chart, call chart_make.
4. Answer with the numbers in a short list.

title: Make a chart from a data file
examples: make a bar chart of revenue by region from sales_data.csv
plot sales by month
create a pie chart of orders by category
draw a graph of this data
description:
1. Call data_describe to get the column names.
2. Call chart_make with the right x, y and chart type.
3. Return the chart path and one sentence describing what it shows.

title: Extract fields from an invoice
examples: extract the invoice details from invoice.pdf
what is the total amount on this invoice
read the GST number from the invoice
process this invoice
description:
1. Call invoice_extract with the file path.
2. Report invoice number, date, vendor, total and any validation warnings.
3. Mention the saved JSON file path.

title: Read and summarise a document file
examples: summarise report.pdf
read this document and tell me the key points
what does this file say
extract text from this image
description:
1. Use doc_read for PDF/DOCX/TXT, ocr_image for images.
2. Summarise in 5-7 bullet points, quoting page numbers when available.

title: Write and send an email
examples: send an email to rahul@example.com about the meeting
write an email to my manager
email the report summary to priya@example.com
draft a mail
description:
1. Call email_draft with a clear subject and a short professional body.
2. If the user asked to send it, call email_send with the draft_id (this asks the user for confirmation).
3. If they only asked for a draft, show the draft and stop.

title: Do a task in a website with the browser
examples: open http://localhost:8001 and click the dynamic store link
go to this site and search for laptops
fill the form on this page
take a screenshot of this website
description:
1. browser_open the URL.
2. browser_find the element you need.
3. browser_click or browser_type using the element number.
4. Repeat as needed; take a screenshot at the end if useful.
5. Stop and ask the user on CAPTCHA or login pages.

title: Remember or recall a fact
examples: remember that my manager is Priya
remember I prefer reports in excel
what did I tell you about my manager
do you remember my preference
description: To remember: call memory_save with one clear sentence. To recall: call memory_search. Never store passwords, OTPs or card numbers.
